test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a68e45d38ce0acb8ec6d8044a215c5a99d099e935803fdfc420592a200d167bb.png]
solution:
From the given dice,

3 is the common number in the both dice,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6a1824a38a921ff96ccc4042fd14abd0051fd85863163fd524559fab070b870.png] 

And, 1, 2, 5, and 6 is the adjacent surface of 3,

So, the remaining number 4 will be the opposite surface of 3.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
